flawless: The heart of the elfhames beats on undisturbed. You never even reached its roots.
I have guarded this hollow since before your grandmother's grandmother. You changed nothing.
solid: Bark and bone, you have scarred me. The hollow keeps its secrets yet.
You fought like a storm through the canopy. Storms pass.
close: The hollow shook and I nearly fell with it. Few have pressed me so.
My strength is spent, but the heart of the forest is safe. Barely.
